name: List Trace Item Attributes
description: List Trace Item Attributes List the attribute keys available on a given trace item dataset (spans, logs, trace metrics, etc.), with optional substring and structured filtering. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/trace-items/attributes/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/trace-items/attributes/
List the attribute keys available on a given trace item dataset (spans, logs, trace metrics, etc.), with optional substring and structured filtering.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
Optional: statsPeriod (query) — The period of time for the query, will override the start & end parameters, a number followed by one of: - `d` for days - `h` for hours - `m` for minutes - `s` for seconds - `w` for weeks For example, `24h`, to mean query data starting from 24 hours ago to now.; start (query) — The start of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.; end (query) — The end of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.; environment (query) — The name of environments to filter by.; project (query) — The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects. For example, the following are valid parameters: - `/?project=1234&project=56789` - `/?project=android&project=javascript-react` - `/?project=-1`; dataset (query) — The trace item dataset to list attributes for. One of `itemType` or `dataset` is required.; itemType (query) — Deprecated alias of `dataset`. Use `dataset` instead.; attributeType (query) — Filter to attributes of one or more types. Defaults to all types.; substringMatch (query) — Restrict results to attribute names containing this substring (case-sensitive).; query (query) — Sentry [search syntax](https://docs.sentry.io/concepts/search/) to filter trace items before computing attributes.; cursor (query) — A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.

name: List an Organization's Trace Metrics
description: List an Organization's Trace Metrics **Experimental:** This API is under active development and may change. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/trace-items/metrics/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/trace-items/metrics/
**Experimental:** This API is under active development and may change. List trace metrics (name, type, unit, count, last seen) with optional context.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
Optional: project (query) — The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects. For example, the following are valid parameters: - `/?project=1234&project=56789` - `/?project=android&project=javascript-react` - `/?project=-1`; environment (query) — The name of environments to filter by.; statsPeriod (query) — The period of time for the query, will override the start & end parameters, a number followed by one of: - `d` for days - `h` for hours - `m` for minutes - `s` for seconds - `w` for weeks For example, `24h`, to mean query data starting from 24 hours ago to now.; start (query) — The start of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.; end (query) — The end of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.; query (query) — Search query to filter metrics, using the same syntax as the metrics dataset.; sort (query) — Response field to sort by, prefixed with `-` for descending. Defaults to metric name ascending.; expand (query) — Optional fields to expand. Pass `context` to include each metric's authored context (brief and details), which describes what the metric measures. Requires the `data-browsing-attribute-context` feature; without it the `context` field is omitted.; contextOnly (query) — Return only metrics that have authored context, and include that context in the response. Use this to discover the metrics that are described well enough to query confidently. Requires the `data-browsing-attribute-context` feature; without it this is a no-op.

name: Compute statistics, such as attribute value distributions, over the trace items (spans or occurrences) matching the given query within the requested time range.
description: Compute statistics, such as attribute value distributions, over the trace items (spans or occurrences) matching the given query within the requested time range. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/trace-items/stats/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/trace-items/stats/
Compute statistics, such as attribute value distributions, over the trace items (spans or occurrences) matching the given query within the requested time range.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; statsType (query) — The statistics to compute over the matching trace items.
Optional: project (query) — The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects. For example, the following are valid parameters: - `/?project=1234&project=56789` - `/?project=android&project=javascript-react` - `/?project=-1`; environment (query) — The name of environments to filter by.; statsPeriod (query) — The period of time for the query, will override the start & end parameters, a number followed by one of: - `d` for days - `h` for hours - `m` for minutes - `s` for seconds - `w` for weeks For example, `24h`, to mean query data starting from 24 hours ago to now.; start (query) — The start of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.; end (query) — The end of the period of time for the query, expected in ISO-8601 format. For example, `2001-12-14T12:34:56.7890`.; itemType (query) — The trace item dataset to compute statistics for. Defaults to `spans`.; query (query) — Sentry [search syntax](https://docs.sentry.io/concepts/search/) to filter trace items before computing statistics.; substringMatch (query) — Restrict results to attribute names containing this substring (case-sensitive).; traceItemsLimit (query) — Maximum number of trace items to sample when computing statistics. Defaults to `1000`, which is also the maximum.; cursor (query) — A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.
